query: What visit-note signals suggest high urgency?

per_column.name: symptom_severity
per_column.rationale: Severity graded from note text is a strong, directly relevant axis for urgency analysis. Samples are well-grounded (mild fatigue->mild, moderate acne->moderate); 'not_present' correctly handles silent rows.

per_column.name: onset_acuity
per_column.rationale: Onset timing (sudden/acute/subacute/chronic) is a classic urgency signal and gives real grouping leverage. Samples map soundly (twisting injury yesterday->acute_hours, cough x3 days->subacute_days, post-MI 6mo->chronic).

per_column.name: presentation_type
per_column.rationale: Categorizes clinical context (acute illness, trauma, chronic followup), a useful new axis for urgency. Well-grounded in samples, with some overlap with visit_purpose but not a mere restatement.

per_column.name: organ_system_involved
per_column.rationale: Organ system is a reasonable stratifier for urgency (e.g. cardiovascular/neurological weighting) and readings are sound (knee->musculoskeletal, cough->respiratory). Slightly weaker direct link to urgency than severity/onset.

per_column.name: visit_purpose
per_column.rationale: Largely overlaps presentation_type and closely tracks the existing 'urgency' column (urgent_sick_visit/emergency_evaluation), reducing new analytical leverage. Values mostly grounded, though acne coded 'urgent_sick_visit' is a questionable read for a routine chronic visit.

per_column.name: diagnostic_workup_urgency
per_column.rationale: Workup urgency inferred from ordered labs/imaging is a distinct, valuable urgency signal. Samples grounded (MRI to rule out tear->urgent_imaging, lipid panel routine->routine_labs).

judge.rationale: The added columns collectively provide multiple genuine, non-trivial axes (severity, onset timing, workup urgency) directly relevant to identifying high-urgency visit-note signals, and values are consistently well-grounded in the note text with appropriate 'not_present' handling for silent rows. visit_purpose is the weakest, largely redundant with presentation_type and near-restating the existing urgency column, and one sample (acne as urgent_sick_visit) is a mildly unwarranted read. No clear hallucinations observed overall.
